text.lead: Tikkun is a 2015 Israeli film directed by Avishai Sivan. The film explores the struggles of a young Hasidic man who questions his faith.
text.plot: Haim-Aron, a young Hasidic student, feels detached from his religious way of life. Following a near death experience, the young man faces an intense spiritual crisis and finds himself at odds with the Hasidic religious faith.
